list: official 55 trophies as published by PlayStation, read 2026-11-20

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.window: No window: every part stays open after the credits
trophies.guide: The platinum is a receipt for the other 54: it has no separate objective and no online, multiplayer or DLC step, and there is no difficulty setting to pick. One playthrough covers the list, with a single Chapter 1 exception - the balcony meditation counted by Positive Mental Attitude - so take that before Chapter 1 closes. PowerPyx puts the run at roughly 200 hours at 4/10 difficulty; the long pole is A Long Road and its 100% checklist, not any single mission.
steps: Take the Chapter 1 balcony meditation first; it is the only thing the platinum can lose.
Play the 91 story missions of Chapters 1-5; twelve story trophies fall out of them.
Finish the seven side strands, then the open-world activities and collections.
Close out with the 100% checklist, which is A Long Road, and the platinum follows.

sources.name: Leonipedia - GTA 6 trophy list and platinum roadmap

trophies.roadmap: 100% completion, then the platinum

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the second mission of the game, straight after the Prologue, and the first one you play as Jason: a smuggling drop with Cal and Donnie that goes wrong in Kingfishers country. Nothing optional sits inside it, so finishing the mission is the whole job - the trophy lands on the results screen. If you are replaying for cleanup, this is already done; story missions cannot be replayed once the credits roll.
steps: Finish the Prologue, which hands straight into Gone Fishing.
Follow Cal through the boat drop and the Kingfishers camp.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops with the mission-complete screen.

trophies.roadmap: The spine: 91 missions across five chapters

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 is 22 missions running from the Prologue to the chapter finale, and the trophy is awarded for closing it. It arrives late: the counter only ticks over after What's in the Bag?, the first main mission of Chapter 2, so do not panic when the chapter ends and nothing pops. There is no missable step in the chapter for this trophy itself, though the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude closes at the same time.
steps: Clear the 22 Chapter 1 missions, ending with the chapter finale.
Play the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag?, and the trophy appears.

trophies.roadmap: The spine: 91 missions across five chapters

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 holds 11 main missions and ends with Checking Out; the trophy is late by one, unlocking after Welcome to Vice City, the opening mission of Chapter 3. Chapter 2 is also where the two protagonists start roaming together, after Coffee Break, which unlocks several partner trophies - so it is worth doing the optional work in this chapter before pushing on.
steps: Play the 11 Chapter 2 missions through Checking Out.
Start Chapter 3 with Welcome to Vice City; the trophy unlocks there.

trophies.roadmap: The spine: 91 missions across five chapters

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 is the longest at 26 missions and the chapter that hands over the tools most of the list depends on: the Snap Gun for silent jewelry jobs, the Dye Pack Jammer for fencing marked bills, and the Key Cloner for high-end cars. The chapter trophy does not pop on the finale - it waits for Ocean Beach and Another Life, the first two missions of Chapter 4.
steps: Clear the 26 Chapter 3 missions; pick up the Snap Gun, Dye Pack Jammer and Key Cloner as they come.
Play Ocean Beach and Another Life in Chapter 4 to collect the trophy.

sources.name: GTABase - GTA 6 mission list and walkthroughs

trophies.roadmap: The spine: 91 missions across five chapters

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 runs 25 missions and closes with Starting From Zero; the trophy is awarded when that final mission ends, so it is one of the few chapter trophies that arrives on time. Chapter 4 is also where the optional vault mission opens, which is the gateway to Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play and the best money in the game.
steps: Play the 25 Chapter 4 missions, including Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown.
Finish Starting From Zero, the chapter finale, to collect the trophy.

sources.name: GTA6Bugs - GTA 6 mission list (91 story missions)

trophies.roadmap: The spine: 91 missions across five chapters

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the campaign: The End of the Road, the last of Chapter 5's seven missions. Sources disagree on the trigger - Leonipedia names The End of the Road, while PowerPyx ties it to Starting From Zero, the Chapter 4 finale - so expect it either at the credits or one mission earlier. Free roam continues afterwards, but finished missions cannot be replayed and there is no New Game+, so keep a manual save before the finale if you care about the other ending.
steps: Play Chapter 5 through Operation Savage Glory to The End of the Road.
Keep a manual save before the finale: the ending depends on choices and missions cannot be replayed.
Finish the last mission; free roam and every remaining trophy stay open.

sources.name: Game Checklists - All Missables in GTA 6

trophies.roadmap: The spine: 91 missions across five chapters

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 main mission and the trophy fires during it rather than at the results screen, so it can appear before the mission is over. There is nothing to prepare and nothing optional inside it; the only thing worth knowing is that it is one of the missions that opens the partner content, so the chapter is worth slowing down in.
steps: Progress Chapter 2 until Breakfast Run appears.
Play it through; the trophy unlocks before the mission ends.
trophies.roadmap: The spine: 91 missions across five chapters

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A Chapter 3 story mission, so the trophy is automatic. Do not confuse it with the optional bank vault robberies: those belong to Maximum Withdrawal and only open later, with the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is... The Cartel Heist is scripted, pays whatever it pays, and leaves the vault system untouched.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3 and complete it.
Ignore the vault side content here; it unlocks a chapter later.
trophies.roadmap: The spine: 91 missions across five chapters

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a Chapter 4 main mission and the trophy is automatic. GTA VI has no gold-medal objectives inside missions, so there is no optional goal you can fail and no way to come out of the mission without the trophy. Headliners, the mission behind DWNFALL, sits in the same chapter.
steps: Play Chapter 4 to Child's Play and finish it.
No optional objective exists; the trophy is unavoidable.

sources.name: GTABase - GTA 6 mission list and walkthroughs

trophies.roadmap: The spine: 91 missions across five chapters

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a Chapter 4 main mission and the trophy is awarded by the mission itself. Nothing to prepare, nothing to miss, and no difficulty setting changes it. It shares the chapter with Child's Play, which carries Family Matters, so a single pass through Chapter 4 clears both.
steps: Play Chapter 4 to Headliners and complete it.
The trophy unlocks with the mission.
trophies.roadmap: The spine: 91 missions across five chapters

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 main mission set at Vice City International Airport, and the trophy is automatic. It is separate from the airport stunt trophy Catch Me If You Can, which needs a stolen airliner and can be done in free roam at any time - finishing this mission does not award that one.
steps: Play Chapter 4 to VCIA Takedown and finish the mission.
Do not expect Catch Me If You Can here; that is a free-roam stunt.
trophies.roadmap: The spine: 91 missions across five chapters

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 main mission and the trophy is automatic. Chapter 5 is short - seven missions - and runs from here to The End of the Road, so this one arrives close to the gold for finishing the campaign.
steps: Play Chapter 5 to Operation Savage Glory.
Complete the mission; the trophy unlocks with it.

sources.name: GTA6Bugs - GTA 6 mission list (91 story missions)

trophies.roadmap: The spine: 91 missions across five chapters

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.window: No window: everything on the checklist stays open in free roam
trophies.guide: 100% is a checklist, not a second playthrough, and it appears only after the credits: Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. PowerPyx's count is partial on purpose - 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 standard weapons, 300 of 397 stunts and 100 optional tasks - but it wants every gang operation, bank job, payday loan, vault, underwater discovery, video game, shooting-range gold, drone trial and hunting deck. Nothing on it is missable, and work done before the credits already counts.
steps: Scan vehicles and study animals from the first hour; binoculars are enough for animals.
Clear the fixed sets as you go: 39 gang operations, 8 vaults, all payday loans, all video games.
After the credits open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and read what is left.
Finish the leftovers in free roam; the gold lands with the last entry.
trophies.roadmap: 100% completion, then the platinum

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.window: No window: stunts stay on the map in free roam
trophies.guide: There are 397 stunts and any 250 count. The mix is 202 Under the Bridges, 130 Stunt Jumps off ramps, 40 Knife Flights between buildings and 25 Base Jumps - and the bridge flights are the quickest of the four, so a bridge run along the coast clears most of the requirement in an afternoon. A stunt counts once performed; the small challenge on its map icon is not needed. The Activities page breaks the count down by category and county, and the 130 jumps are spread over five counties, Vice-Dale holding 55.
steps: Open the map's Exploration filter and switch on Stunt Spots to see what is left.
Farm Under the Bridges along the coast and the rivers; they are the fastest 202.
Top up with Stunt Jumps in Vice-Dale County if you are short.
Check the Activities page until the counter passes 250.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types have to be tried once each: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting ranges, pool, basketball (one scored hoop is enough), a video game, a stunt, and a won race of any kind - car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race. The Activities page of the Progress menu lists the nine and how often each has been done, so the trophy is a checklist rather than a challenge. The story introduces most of them; the rest appear as the map unfogs.
steps: Open Progress > Activities and read the nine types with their counters.
Knock off the cheap ones: one hoop, one pool frame, one stunt, one video game.
Win any single race, including a Top Fun drone trial, to close the ninth.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.window: No window: both ranges stay open
trophies.guide: Two ranges hold 42 gold medals between them. Griffin Shooting Range, north-west of Vice City, has six courses at three difficulty levels - 18 golds, timed obstacle runs. Rodgers Ranch, north-east of Port Gellhorn, has six courses at four levels - 24 golds, scored from a standing position where hits build a multiplier and a miss drops it. A $5 Waiver Pass from each range's shop unlocks the challenges, and renting a weapon for $10 per attempt is good enough for every gold.
steps: Buy the Waiver Pass at each range so the challenges appear on the map.
Clear Griffin's six courses at all three levels: 18 golds.
Clear Rodgers Ranch's six courses at all four levels: 24 golds, keeping the multiplier alive.
Track medals under Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Fourteen Top Fun sites, three time trials each, 42 races in all - and the trophy wants a win at every site. A site's icon appears when you are within about 100 metres, and the map's Activities filter lists Top Fun Drones. Beating par on a site's first two trials opens the third. Which result counts as a win for the trophy is not documented yet, so treat a par time as the target rather than a finish. Full stick forward and a clean line beat most pars.
steps: Find each site by driving within 100 m, or read the Top Fun Drones map filter.
Beat par on trials one and two to unlock the third.
Win at all 14 sites; 100% wants all 42 trials finished as well.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.window: No window: race spots stay open
trophies.guide: Forty unique races exist and 20 wins are needed, so half the calendar will do. Seventeen belong to two street crews - Hit 'N Run VC at four spots in Vice City, Animal Crackers across Lummox and Mariana - and the rest sit on four tracks: Gellhorn International Raceway has 11, Thrillbilly Mud Club 8, Boone Speedway 2 elimination races and Ambrosia Raceway 2 demolition races. Entry and car rental are paid up front and a win more than covers them. Hit 'N Run VC opens in Chapter 3.
steps: Open the map's Racing filter and mark every race spot you have found.
Start at Gellhorn: an intro race leads into a five-race amateur series and then the rest.
Take the eight Thrillbilly Mud Club races once Billy's strand opens the club.
Win 20 different races; 100% wants 30, so keep going past the trophy.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.window: No window: Cal's challenge stays on the map
trophies.guide: Cal Hampton's fishing challenge arrives by text after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, and it drops a purple fishing icon on the map rather than a story marker. Beat him in the contest and the trophy is yours. The challenge also counts as one of the 100 optional tasks the 100% checklist wants, and fishing is one of the nine types Master of None tracks, so it earns its keep three times over.
steps: Play Feng Shui in Chapter 1 and wait for Cal's text.
Follow the purple fishing icon and take the challenge.
Land the better catch to beat Cal; the trophy follows the result.
trophies.roadmap: Side strands and the partner jobs

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.window: Console is off limits for most of Chapter 2 and returns in Chapter 3
trophies.guide: Four video games are playable and one of them, cleared level by level, is enough. Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind run on the JoySystem console by the TV at home; Bang For Your Buck only exists on arcade machines, one of which stands outside the Bargain World clothing store in Port Gellhorn. The console is unusable for most of Chapter 2 and comes back in Chapter 3, which is the only reason to think about timing - the arcade cabinet is always there.
steps: Pick Bang For Your Buck at the Port Gellhorn arcade machine if the console is locked.
Or clear Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the JoySystem at home.
Finish every level of that one game; its side challenges do not matter.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.window: No window: the strand stays open after the credits
trophies.guide: Andy's strand is Lucia's alone and opens in Chapter 3: Andy phones her, then texts his home address in Belville, which puts the strand on the map. It is five quests, starting with Climbing the Cellerichain (played in three parts) and ending with Puff Puff Pass at the warehouse, which is the one that pays the trophy. Leonipedia reports it stays playable in free roam after the credits and that it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so do not expect it to help that silver.
steps: In Chapter 3, take Andy's call and read the text that marks Belville.
Play the five quests in order; the first is Climbing the Cellerichain.
Finish Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse) for the trophy.
trophies.roadmap: Side strands and the partner jobs

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.window: No window: Kenton returns later and the strand survives the credits
trophies.guide: Kenton Rees runs the treasure-diving strand. It starts in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams, when Kenton calls and a green KR icon appears in Key Lento; the work is diving shipwrecks with a metal detector and selling each batch back at his shop. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and picks up again in Chapter 2 or 3 - phoning Brian as Jason late in Chapter 2 brings the text forward. Seven wrecks in all, and the last mission pays the trophy.
steps: After Island Dreams, answer Kenton's call and visit the KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive the marked wrecks, dig with the metal detector, and return each batch.
Finish the seventh wreck's mission for the trophy; the strand reopens if Kenton goes quiet.
trophies.roadmap: Side strands and the partner jobs

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.window: No window: all five quests stay open after the credits
trophies.guide: Billy's strand appears after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County, and runs five quests from Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club) to Hometown Heroes (Join Billy on a Job), which pays the trophy. The first quest also opens the club's eight races, six on dirt and two on the oval - useful for Earn Cash, Not Kudos, which wants wins in 20 different races.
steps: After Coffee Break, drive to the Thrillbilly Mud Club and start Thrillbillies.
Play the strand's five quests in order.
Finish Hometown Heroes for the trophy; the club races stay open for Earn Cash, Not Kudos.
trophies.roadmap: Side strands and the partner jobs

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.window: At risk: Race Against Yago is an hourglass mission in Chapter 3
trophies.missable_reason: The trophy counts strands, and one of them can be lost: Race Against Yago is a timed mission in Chapter 3 and letting its hourglass run out can close Yago's strand for good, leaving the counter short of eight (Game Checklists; Leonipedia). Every other strand survives the credits.
trophies.guide: Eight strands is a counting job, not a tour: not every stranger questline counts toward the silver. The only reliable check is the trophy counter in the list - read it before and after a strand's last mission. Leonipedia had four counting strands confirmed at the time of writing, so plan on playing more than eight and watch for hourglass missions, which fail if you dawdle. Doing Race Against Yago the moment it appears is the one thing that protects the trophy.
steps: Open the trophy list and note the counter before each strand's final mission.
Work through the strands most likely to count - Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and Cal - and watch the counter after each.
Start any mission with an hourglass icon immediately, especially Race Against Yago in Chapter 3.
Re-check the counter until it reads eight.

sources.name: Game Checklists - All Missables in GTA 6

trophies.roadmap: Side strands and the partner jobs

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.window: No window: deliveries stay open after the credits
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List is a car-thief strand. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy), which also hands over the Key Cloner and delivers the first car, a Granforma Zorrusso. The list lives under Robberies in the map, Randy's marker is a green RK icon in western Vice City, and the WAiNK app tells you whether a car you are looking at is on it. PowerPyx counts 16 sports cars; its money guide says 18.
steps: Play Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 and keep the Key Cloner.
Open Randy's Wish List under Robberies and work down it.
Steal the listed sports cars, checking each with WAiNK, and deliver them to the RK icon.
trophies.roadmap: Side strands and the partner jobs

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.window: No window: the strand survives the credits
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand is Jason's and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers point at Synthetic Labs around Vice City, and the first quest is Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs Tyrone hands over a second quest, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), and that one pays the trophy. How many labs are needed is not documented yet, so treat the strand as open ended and keep destroying them. Each lab also counts as an optional task toward 100%.
steps: After Here, Kitty Kitty, look for the purple Synthetic Labs markers as Jason.
Clear Take Out Kitty Litter, destroying labs until Tyrone calls again.
Finish Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs) for the trophy.
trophies.roadmap: Side strands and the partner jobs

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.window: One meditation is offered only in Chapter 1, at Jason's house
trophies.missable_reason: The official description asks for every spot, and one of the 18 meditations - Lucia's, on the balcony of Jason's house - is offered only during Chapter 1 and is gone once Chapter 2 starts. Whether the trophy actually needs it is not yet confirmed; the 100% checklist needs only 15 of the 18. Sources: Leonipedia meditation guide, PowerPyx roadmap, Game Checklists.
trophies.guide: Eighteen meditations across ten spots, and the counter is the thing to watch: Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. Spots 2 to 9 give two meditations each because Jason and Lucia both sit, so bring your partner along once switching opens after Chapter 2. The tenth, a stone circle on the summit of Mount Kalaga (Ascent Mountain), stays hidden until the other seventeen are done. The odd one out is the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1 - do it before the chapter closes.
steps: In Chapter 1, accept Lucia's offer to meditate on the balcony; it never returns.
Visit the eight map spots with both characters, two meditations per visit.
Finish the seventeenth meditation to reveal Ascent Mountain, then take both characters up.
Confirm 18/18 under Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

sources.name: Game Checklists - All Missables in GTA 6

trophies.roadmap: Chapter 1: the one window that closes

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.window: No window: Bret's decks stay open after the credits
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting strand reaches Jason only, some time after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, by text. The opener is Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) in Lummox County; after that Bret marks hunting grounds in purple and asks for particular animals, which make up the 15 Target Decks - and 100% completion wants every deck, so the trophy comes with the checklist. The unique animal is the trophy's own requirement and arrives inside the strand rather than in the decks.
steps: Wait for Bret's text to Jason after Coffee Break and play Veteran Hunted.
Work the purple hunting grounds; track decks under Activities or Contacts.
Finish the request that asks for the unique animal to unlock the trophy.
trophies.roadmap: Side strands and the partner jobs

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.window: No window: cards stay where they are
trophies.guide: Three of the eighteen card sets is the ask, out of 480 unique cards. Ten sets hold 24 cards and five hold 36; the stragglers are Vice City Club De Futbol with 30, Delights Dancers with 18 and Backyard Wrestling with 12 - so the wrestling set is the cheapest route to a third. Cards cannot be bought, only picked up: indoors look on surfaces and walls, outdoors check the yellow phone boxes and tool boxes. Colour variants count as separate cards. Progress sits under Collections > Collectible Cards.
steps: Open Collections > Collectible Cards and pick the two smallest sets plus one more.
Sweep indoors first; outdoor cards hide in yellow phone boxes and tool boxes.
Sell duplicates at a pawn shop if you like - a sold card stays in the collection.
Complete three sets; 100% wants fifteen, so keep going.
trophies.roadmap: Collections and exploration

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: A hundred scans with the phone app, in any mix of sets: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures, the No Flusher Tags and a fifth set nobody has identified yet. Near a scannable spot the controller buzzes, a sound plays and a notice appears bottom right; hold up on the d-pad, point at the starburst icon and press R1. Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures are the eye-catching ones; No Flusher Tags are paint marks on urban ground. The running total is under Collections > WAiNK Locations.
steps: Hold up on the d-pad to open WAiNK without going through the phone menu.
Scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures first; they are the easiest to spot.
Ignore AHOL Street Art and 1010 Murals - they use the app but do not count.
Scan until the counter reads 100, which is also what 100% wants.

sources.name: PowerPyx - GTA 6 All WAiNK Scan Locations

trophies.roadmap: Collections and exploration

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.window: No window: all 80 challenges are open from the start
trophies.guide: Eighty challenges, ten in each of eight categories - Combat, Criminal, Exploration, Fitness, Shopping, Sports, Survival and Vehicle - and any 50 count, so the hardest can be skipped. They have their own page in the Progress menu and a finished one shows a Completed tick when you highlight it. Leave this until late: most fall out of the other trophies and the 100% checklist, which itself wants 70, so the trophy arrives on the way.
steps: Open the Challenges page and sort out which ten are closest to done.
Play the other trophies first; they fill most categories without trying.
Finish the quickest remaining challenges to reach 50.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.window: Needs partner roaming, which opens after Coffee Break
trophies.guide: Once the two protagonists can roam together - after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break - call your partner over, cause enough trouble for four stars and then get clear. The unlock waits until you are outside the red heat zone, so simply leaving the flashing search area is not enough. A fast sports bike through traffic is the usual answer, and firing at the helicopter makes it back off; the railway tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good place to vanish.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner to your side.
Raise a four-star wanted level with them along for the ride.
Escape until the red heat zone is behind you, not just the search circle.
trophies.roadmap: Side strands and the partner jobs

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.window: Needs partner roaming and the jewelry stores, both Chapter 3
trophies.guide: Three robbery targets, back to back, with your partner beside you and the wanted level never dropping between them - that is the whole trick, and the red heat level alone does not count. Chaining the jewelry stores in the north of Vice City is the standard route; take a few items in each and blow the back-room safe with sticky bombs where you can. Wait about thirty seconds after leaving the third shop, and keep robbing if the trophy has not appeared.
steps: Unlock partner roaming (Coffee Break) and the jewelry stores (Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs).
Rob three stores in a row without letting the wanted level fall.
Bring a vest, sticky bombs and healing for the chase; wait 30 seconds after the third shop.
trophies.roadmap: Side strands and the partner jobs

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discovery means scanning, not driving: open WAiNK with the shortcut, point it at a vehicle you have not logged and scan it. Park by a busy road and work through the traffic, and remember boats and aircraft, which are easy to forget. The Vehicles page of the Progress menu shows totals by category. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so the trophy is a waypoint rather than a destination - and standout vehicles found at fixed spots do not count toward that 200.
steps: Scan every new model you pass from the first hour of the story.
Camp a busy Vice City road and scan traffic until the counter climbs.
Cover boats and aircraft too; they are separate categories.
trophies.roadmap: Collections and exploration

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time and lights up weak points for a few seconds, and the trophy wants five enemies down or incapacitated inside one activation. Pick an illegal gang operation for targets - soldiers, police and civilians seem not to count - and prepare before the fight: eat, drink or wash at home to fill the purple focus gauge, take Adrenaline to stretch the duration, and wear armour so you can step out of cover. A full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556 is more accurate than a pistol or SMG.
steps: Fill focus at home, then take Adrenaline before the fight.
Attack a gang operation where several enemies stand close together.
Trigger Combat Focus with a rifle raised and drop five before it ends.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an airliner from Vice City International and fly it out. The plane has to be docked at a passenger boarding bridge of a departure terminal - the ones parked on the airfield do not count - and gates E3 and E4 are the usual pick. Climb to the cockpit, reverse onto the runway and take off; the trophy only fires about a kilometre out. Driving through the perimeter fence and up the stairs beside the bridge is much quicker than walking the terminal.
steps: Drive through the airfield fence to gates E3/E4 and climb the boarding-bridge stairs.
Enter the airliner, go upstairs to the cockpit and reverse onto the runway.
Take off and fly about 1 km out for the trophy.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The riddle is a tank: Rhinos. Tanks sit in the southern half of Mile Zero Air Station, the air base on the island in the far south-west of the map in Mariana County. Get in by driving through the gate or by taking the stunt jump beside the south-east entrance, then fire at some enemies - the trophy follows a few shots. It is a free-roam stunt, so it can be done at any point in the story.
steps: Fly or drive to Mile Zero Air Station in southern Mariana County.
Enter the base through the gate or the stunt jump at the south-east entrance.
Board a tank and fire on enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The twenty jewelry stores unlock midway through Chapter 3 with the Snap Gun, and the gadget is the whole trophy: at the back door the game offers a kick, which trips the alarm, or the Snap Gun, which opens it quietly. Choose the gadget, then keep the alarm disarmed - kicking another door, smashing a case or a witness can still set it off, and the security panel in the back room turns it off. The safe code is on a note in the back room. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the usual first try.
steps: Get the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3.
Approach a jewelry store's back door and pick the Snap Gun, never the kick.
Disarm the panel, read the safe code note and empty the safe without being seen.
trophies.roadmap: Side strands and the partner jobs

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.window: No window: vaults can be robbed again later
trophies.guide: Five of the eight large vaults, each followed by a clean escape. Every vault runs the same way: tail a security van to the bank, wait for a guard to carry the case in and the vault to open, slip in while it stays open, and bring your partner because one character cannot carry it all. Four stars follow immediately, so escape on a bike through traffic and swap vehicles. The eight banks are four in Ocean Beach, two in Downtown, one in Tequesta and one at VCIA, and a vault can pay up to $205,000.
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is... in Chapter 4 to open vault robberies.
Tail a security van, enter while the vault is open and take both bags with your partner.
Shake the four stars on a fast bike, then change vehicles.
Repeat at any five of the eight banks.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Two routes, both valid. The slower one is a vault job: robbing a large bank's vault counts as an armored truck robbery, so the optional Chapter 4 mission that introduces vaults awards it. The quicker one is on the street - armored trucks circulate near the banks in Vice City, so cut one off, stick a sticky bomb on the rear doors and detonate it. Either way the trophy waits until you are out of the red heat zone or through a Pay 'n' Spray.
steps: Buy sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation, or from the fence's back room once his jobs are done.
Ambush an armored truck near a Vice City bank and blow the rear doors.
Take the cash and clear the heat zone for the trophy.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.window: No window: free roam continues after the credits
trophies.guide: The trophy is the fog: when no part of the map is still black, it unlocks. The quick way is from the air - take a plane and fly over each dark patch in turn, county by county across Leonida's five (Vice-Dale, Kelly, Leonard, Lummox and Mariana). Doing it early pays twice, because unfogging an area is what puts banks, payday loan offices and stick-up stores on the map, and every one of those is an entry in the 100% checklist.
steps: Steal or buy a plane and take off from any airfield.
Fly a grid over each county, watching for black patches on the map.
Repeat until nothing is left under fog; the trophy fires on the last patch.

sources.name: GTA Wiki (gta.wiki) - Grand Theft Auto VI

trophies.roadmap: Collections and exploration

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.window: No window: robbed operations come back
trophies.guide: One illegal operation per gang, out of the 39 PowerPyx counts. Entering an operation's area gives it a yellow icon; story progress marks 19 of the 39 for you, and the map's Robberies filter lists the ones you have found. Take every key valuable or the robbery does not count as complete - they are usually one-off weapon variants, watches or a cash safe. The Gangs page of the Progress menu shows, gang by gang, how many you have robbed.
steps: Open the Robberies map filter and clear each operation's key valuables.
Check Progress > Gangs to see which gangs are still owed a robbery.
Cover the eight named gangs; the ninth is disputed between PowerPyx's guides.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A drink, not a heist. The bar is the rooftop of the Ocean View Hotel on the Ocean Beach seafront in Vice City - the neon sign is the landmark - and the mistake people make is searching the ground floor. Get to the upper terrace, order at the rooftop counter and drink it with the view; the trophy lands shortly after. Atelier Gaming's write-up is the source for the rooftop; treat the exact route upstairs as approximate, since it may depend on which entrance you use.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and find the Ocean View Hotel by its neon sign.
Take the stairs or lift to the rooftop terrace rather than the lobby bar.
Order a cocktail at the counter and drink it; the trophy follows.

sources.name: Atelier Gaming - GTA 6, le trophee In The Beginning

trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.window: No window: the showroom car respawns
trophies.guide: The blue Banshee in the Sunrise Autos showroom in Southside, South Vice-Dale County, is the car, and the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS is what lets you take it. Get in, start it, and drive out through the showroom window - the smash is the trophy. GTAVibes and PowerPyx both describe the same showroom and the same requirement, and gtaculture still lists the method as unconfirmed, so read this one as reported rather than settled.
steps: Earn the Key Cloner in Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS.
Drive to Sunrise Autos in Southside and clone the blue Banshee.
Start it and drive straight out through the showroom glass.

sources.name: GTAVibes - How to steal the Banshee (Capital Offense)

trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.window: No window: the robbed site reopens later
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a Kolt & Associates illegal operation, introduced by the optional Chapter 2 mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Take all three key valuables and then escape the police - the trophy comes after the escape, not when the last item is grabbed, and the gang members inside do not have to die. Two valuables carry golden icons: a watch in the south-east office and the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner; the third is the office safe, which wants sticky bombs.
steps: Buy sticky bombs, then start Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2.
Take the watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe in the north-east office.
Escape the police for the trophy; the operation also counts for Pest Control.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.window: No window: home workouts open after the credits
trophies.guide: Both protagonists have to hold maximum Strength at the same time, which is why this is a partnership trophy rather than a story one. Character switching opens after Coffee Break; check each character's Strength under Jason & Lucia in the touchpad menu. A fitness club membership is the fast route, and calling your partner over before a workout means both train at once. After the story you can also work out at home, so it cannot be lost.
steps: After Coffee Break, buy a fitness club membership from the Activities map filter.
Call your partner over, then work out so both characters gain Strength together.
Repeat until both are at maximum Strength at the same time.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.window: No window: the counter keeps rising
trophies.guide: A long counter that fills as you play: 500 actions that shift your criminal profile, which most players reach without trying. Turn on the HUD notification for the criminal profile to see a small demon face whenever one counts, and select the trophy in the list to read the counter. Stealth and clean getaways push Professional, limb shots that spare enemies push Hardened, kills push Violent and then Psycho. Farm the rest by running over civilians and police, but stay clear of Irredeemable, which is permanent.
steps: Enable Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile to watch the counter move.
Play normally; robberies and fights all feed it.
If short at the end, farm it with vehicles - and stop before the Irredeemable tier.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No reliable unlock has been published, and this guide will not invent one. The description - second time's the charm - points at a retry, and PowerPyx's current belief is that it involves the Payday Loans store seen in the prologue; gtaculture and PlayStationTrophies both still mark the method unconfirmed. Practical advice: keep a manual save before prologue-era robberies, fail one and succeed on the second attempt, and check the trophy list after each. It is not flagged missable by any source.
steps: Keep a manual save before any prologue robbery you attempt.
Try the Payday Loans store twice: fail or abort once, then succeed.
Check the trophy list after each attempt; the method is still unconfirmed.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.window: No window: the event repeats at night
trophies.guide: A UFO encounter in Kelly County, on the rural road east of Port Gellhorn near the Starlet Motel. Be there at about 2:00 AM in-game time with Chapter 2 open, and look for a parked car with flashing lights and open doors; follow the scattered clothes and the static toward the beam of light. Help the woman on the ground, take the dialogue, then walk back to the road for her vehicle - which is when the UFO takes you instead. The trophy lands as the encounter closes.
steps: Reach Chapter 2, then travel to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel after 2 AM.
Follow the blinking car, the clothes and the light beam into the trees.
Help the woman, answer the dialogue, then return to the road.

sources.name: Beebom - GTA 6 UFO location and The Truth Is Out There

trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed, and flagged as such. The description asks for a melee drive-by that bowls someone over, and PowerPyx's current belief is that kicking enemies from a moving motorcycle does it - which matches the wording better than ramming them with a car. Try it in traffic or against a gang operation: ride alongside a target, melee from the saddle, and check the list. No source flags it missable.
steps: Ride a motorcycle up beside a pedestrian or gang member.
Use the melee attack from the saddle rather than a weapon.
Check the trophy list; the method is PowerPyx's working theory, not a confirmed one.
trophies.roadmap: Open-world activities, robberies and one-off stunts

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come out of banks and payday loan offices and can only be cleaned once the story hands you the Dye Pack Jammer, which arrives with the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check. Sell the bills to a fence; the total accumulates across every delivery, so no single huge haul is needed. Yasmani in Little Cuba pays the most, and large bank vaults are the fastest source at up to $205,000 a job. The 100% checklist wants the same $250,000 fenced, so the trophy comes with it.
steps: Get the Dye Pack Jammer from Credit Check in Chapter 3.
Rob banks and payday loan offices for marked bills, using vaults once Chapter 4 opens them.
Sell to Yasmani until the running total passes $250,000.
trophies.roadmap: Money: launder it, spend it, buy the garages

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: A hundred thousand dollars through the tills, and every kind of shop adds to the same total. Guns, car modifications and tattoos are the quickest because they are the most expensive things on the shelves; eight kinds of shop count, among them 24 gun stores, 14 mod shops and 11 tattoo studios, with clothing, footwear, hair and beauty, electronics and Pay 'n' Spray completing the list. Weapons bought here also feed A Long Road's 50-of-66 standard weapons requirement.
steps: Bank the money first: robberies in Chapters 3 and 4 pay best.
Spend on weapons, vehicle mods and tattoos, which carry the highest prices.
Top up across clothing, electronics and Pay 'n' Spray until the total passes $100,000.
trophies.roadmap: Money: launder it, spend it, buy the garages

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Twelve garages exist but only eight are for sale; the other four come free with story progress and do not count. The eight cost between $4,000 and $40,000 each, $160,000 in total, and are bought through the Vice City Real Estate app on the phone, which installs itself shortly after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Each one adds at least one parking spot, and those spots are what On the Spot needs - 18 at most, counting two for personal vehicles left outside.
steps: Wait for the Vice City Real Estate app after Daily Driver in Chapter 2.
Buy the eight garages for sale, cheapest first; skip the four free ones.
Keep the receipt: each garage's parking spots feed On the Spot.
trophies.roadmap: Money: launder it, spend it, buy the garages

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros keeps stolen vehicles on record and brings them to you on request, but each registration needs a parking spot, so buy garages first. The app and Moses's garage in Port Gellhorn arrive with the Chapter 2 mission Moses; drive a stolen vehicle inside, choose Respray and then Register. That garage refuses anything with a tracker at first, but later in Chapter 3 Standard Tracker cars are accepted and any Pay 'n' Spray can register them. Cheap cars and bikes keep the fees down.
steps: Play Moses in Chapter 2 to install Scooter Bros and open the Port Gellhorn garage.
Buy enough garages for ten parking spots.
Steal cheap cars and bikes, then Respray and Register each one until ten are on the app.
trophies.roadmap: Money: launder it, spend it, buy the garages
